description: This file defines the RetellAIPhoneServiceProvider class, implementing AIPhoneServiceProvider for the RETELL_AI type. It provides methods for configuring, managing, and interacting with AI phone services, including creating calls, managing phone numbers, agents, and configurations, and listing resources.

classes.name: RetellAIPhoneServiceProvider
classes.description: A class implementing AIPhoneServiceProvider for RETELL_AI, providing methods to manage AI phone service configurations, agents, calls, and phone numbers.

methods.name: setupConfiguration
methods.description: Sets up AI phone service configuration with provided settings and returns model and agent IDs.

methods.name: deleteConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes AI phone service configuration based on provided deletion info.

methods.name: updateModelConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a specific model by ID.

methods.name: getModelDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific model by ID.

methods.name: getAgent
methods.description: Fetches agent details by agent ID.

methods.name: updateAgent
methods.description: Updates agent information with provided parameters.

methods.name: createPhoneCall
methods.description: Creates a new phone call with specified data.

methods.name: createPhoneNumber
methods.description: Creates a new phone number with specified parameters.

methods.name: importPhoneNumber
methods.description: Imports a phone number with extended parameters.

methods.name: deletePhoneNumber
methods.description: Deletes a phone number, optionally from database.

methods.name: getPhoneNumber
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific phone number.

methods.name: updatePhoneNumber
methods.description: Updates inbound and outbound agent IDs for a phone number.

methods.name: generatePhoneNumberCheckoutSession
methods.description: Generates a checkout session URL for phone number purchase.

methods.name: cancelPhoneNumberSubscription
methods.description: Cancels subscription for a phone number.

methods.name: updatePhoneNumberWithAgents
methods.description: Updates agents associated with a phone number.

methods.name: listAgents
methods.description: Lists agents with optional scope filtering.

methods.name: getAgentWithDetails
methods.description: Retrieves agent details with extended info.

methods.name: createOutboundAgent
methods.description: Creates an outbound agent with specified parameters.

methods.name: createInboundAgent
methods.description: Creates an inbound agent with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateAgentConfiguration
methods.description: Updates agent configuration settings.

methods.name: deleteAgent
methods.description: Deletes an agent by ID.

methods.name: createTestCall
methods.description: Creates a test call for an agent.

methods.name: createWebCall
methods.description: Creates a web-based call for an agent.

methods.name: updateToolsFromAgentId
methods.description: Updates tools associated with an agent ID.

methods.name: removeToolsForEventTypes
methods.description: Removes tools for specified event types.

methods.name: listCalls
methods.description: Lists calls with filtering options.

methods.name: listVoices
methods.description: Lists available voice options.
